evidence.quote: Can we witness any imprint of re-ionisation on the observed Ly$\alpha$ properties? These are the questions that we aim to address.

claims.hypothesis: Is there evidence of a more neutral vicinity at z>6?
claims.experiment: Compare halo scale lengths and velocity offsets to literature
claims.result: Halo sizes similar across redshift; velocity shifts typically smaller
claims.finding: Little indication of more neutral vicinity

evidence.quote: Overall, we find little indications of a more neutral vicinity at higher redshift.
